definitions.gloss: way of teaching; teaching method; teaching style
definitions.explanation: The manner in which something is taught — covering approach, sequence, and pedagogical style. Formed from {教|おし}える + {方|かた} (way of doing).

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教|おし}え{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ。
examples.english: The teacher's way of teaching is skillful.
The way of teaching children differs from teaching adults.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすい{教|おし}え{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This book introduces a teaching method that is easy even for beginners to understand.

notes:
Verb stem + ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ forms a noun meaning 'way of doing X'. Productive with most verbs (⟦{書|か}き{方|かた}→書き方：13054_kakikata⟧, ⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧, ⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教|おし}え{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧: good at teaching
- {教|おし}え{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下手|へた}→下手：00703_heta⟧: bad at teaching
- {教|おし}え{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{工夫|くふう}する→工夫する：22180_kufuusuru⟧: to put thought into one's teaching method
- {教|おし}え{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: to learn how to teach

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {指導法|しどうほう}: instructional method — more formal/technical, often used in education research
- ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧: teaching style — focused on classroom delivery rather than method
